Feature:HR — booking an Anpassung in the Abwesenheitshistorie 4s 79ms 1

A correction that is not an absence (a transfer from another Niederlassung,
say) has no native Odoo record: an allocation cannot be negative and a leave
would show up as an absence. HR books it as an Anpassung directly in the
Abwesenheitshistorie, with a mandatory reason, and the running Gesamt takes
it into account immediately. This is deliberately end-to-end: the editable
grid, the validation dialog and the recomputed Gesamt are OWL list behaviour
no unit test can observe.

Feature:An employee's check-out goes through when it moves the break inside a released visit 7s 494ms 1

Task #486: the office enters a visit and it is released on save (D-K4).
When the employee's own earlier visit of that day reaches the server later,
from the offline queue, the day's break moves inside the released visit
without changing its hours. The released timesheet line was then rewritten
all the same, and Odoo refused that write to the portal employee: the
check-out failed and the queue dropped it. The rule is pinned by the Odoo
unit test test_the_break_moves_within_a_released_entry_without_refusing_the_check_out;
this scenario drives the app's own routes and the rendered form.

@hr @employee-app @regression @task-496
Feature:The Employee App shows a shared device's cache only to the employee it belongs to 41s 267ms 11

Task 496 review: the app keeps its last data and its queued check-ins in
the browser so it starts without a connection, and until #496 that cache
carried no owner. On a device two employees share, the second one booted
into the first one's name and shifts, and their queued taps went out in the
second one's session. Only a browser has that cache, so this is end-to-end:
the app is opened with its API unreachable, which makes it render from the
cache alone. A cache from before the update has no owner recorded and is
matched by the employee's name. Signing out drops the cache, but only once
the server answers: with the connection gone it keeps the employee signed
in with their data rather than half-clearing the device (spec EC-S9). What
a session that ended without Abmelden leaves is cleared at the next
employee's sync, all but the taps it could not send. Those taps, and the
ones another employee left in the cache from before the update, wait for
their owner's next sign-in, oldest first with the employee's own; a queued
tap the server refuses is shown with its reason, and kept for the next
sign-in if the employee signs out before reading it.

@planning @task-357 @regression
Feature:Planning Mitarbeiter picker — stepping outside the own hierarchy 8s 852ms 1

A planner may assign any active employee of the company to a shift, but the
Mitarbeiter dialog still opens on their own team so the everyday list stays
short; reaching the rest of the company is a deliberate act.

End-to-end because the behaviour under test is a rendered search state, not a
computed set. Which employees the planner may assign is already proven at the
unit level by test_planning_company_wide_assignment; what no TransactionCase
can observe is that the dialog opens with the Mein Team facet applied, that
removing it is what widens the visible list, and that a name from the widened
list is selectable and lands on the form. That is AC-1 and AC-2.

It deliberately stops at the form. Saving is covered by
test_planning_company_wide_assignment, including the part a browser test
would have to stage an Objekt for: a shift for somebody outside your team on
a project that is not yours is refused by rule_planning_slot_global_scope,
so "it saves" is two rules interacting rather than one rendering.

unchanged.

missing badge widget in get_view, Save as Template per planner). What only
the browser shows is the dropdown the web client fills from the field's
domain at run time: that it lists the planner's own template and not
another planner's, in the search field that stands where the badge strip
was. This one step is that rendering check, the same shape task 414 used

The month's "Tätigkeiten MM/JJJJ" task used to sit in Planung until somebody
moved it by hand. Since #477 the first hour an employee reports moves it to
Durchführung by itself, if the month has Kontrollstunden, and OdooBot says so
on the task; a month born without them stays in Planung with one reminder.
The rule, its gate and its wording are pinned by the unit tests
(test_project_phase_on_first_time_report.py, 22 cases;
test_employee_pwa_phase_on_first_hour.py, 4 cases). What they cannot show is
the real chain: the move runs in a cr.postcommit hook, after the
Mitarbeiter-App's check-out request has committed, in a transaction of its
own, which a TransactionCase only simulates by draining the queue by hand.

the app, and the Bereichsleiterin reloads the task and reads its phase and
its chatter, in German.

reading an Objekt had to leave it, open Einsatzplanung and filter by project

Objekt's shifts and nothing else.

prove everything the server decides — the button, its group gate and the
action's domain and context. What the web client then does with the context
is the whole point of the task and only a browser shows it: `initialDate`
is the single key the Gantt reads (the calendar view's `initial_date` is
dropped without a word), and the range it opens on can be overruled by the
range the client remembers per Gantt view, which it stores on the first
load of every Gantt. So the browser's clock runs a month behind (a Gantt
that ignored `initialDate` would show other months) and the Planning
menu's Gantt remembers "week", as it does for every real planner. And an
Objekt with nothing planned must open on an empty Gantt: whether the client
fills an empty range with its sample shifts is decided in the browser.

project: the position now joins the Auftrag's project.

surfaced as a dialog on saving it, with the Auftrag's real 6-digit number from
the seeded categories. The unit tests in test_sale_order_create_project.py
prove the rule itself. Two positions are added in one save because core names
the project with the bare number only when the order has more than one
position that creates a project.

not added.

Task #338: a Bereichsleiter confirmed a quotation built from the IFMS service
catalogue and got no project, and the manual "Projekt erstellen" button failed
with an access error, because the role only reads projects. Now the seeded
services create the project on confirmation, the button works as a process
step for that role, and the project is managed by the order's
Vertriebsmitarbeiter, so the Bereichsleiter finds it in their own project list.
Fails before the fix: the project has no manager and the Bereichsleiter cannot
see it (with a product tracking "no", it does not exist at all).
Requires: fixture property "Testobjekt Wien" linked to IFMS GmbH, the seeded
product "Hausreinigung" of wolfinne_ifms_data_prod, and signature images on the
Bereichsleiterin's employee and on the Geschaeftsfuehrung signer, because a
Bereichsleiter cannot choose the signers and the form fills them from the
defaults. The Vertriebsmitarbeiter is set explicitly: the project is led by
the Vertriebsmitarbeiter, and the form pre-fills that field from the
customer's salesperson, which an earlier scenario's Niederlassungsleiter
leaves on "IFMS GmbH"; the project would then be his and invisible to her.

nothing is saved on the way, and the quote is still there afterwards.

which no unit test renders. The unit suite asserts the widget and that the
quote's own rules are untouched.

@sale-order @task-468 @tz-europe-vienna
Feature:A new version of an Auftrag, valid from a day, as the form, the list and the PDF show it 6s 523ms 1

Task #468: a confirmed Auftrag gets a new version with the same number, valid
from a Gültig ab; one version is valid on a day, and the one it replaces is
then Abgelöst. The rules themselves (the Gültig ab checks, at most one version
to come, the version state, the Massenlauf and the project) are proven by the
unit tests of wolfinne_ifms_customization (tests/test_quote_versioning.py) and
are not walked again here. This feature is end-to-end for what only the
browser shows: that the header offers "Neue Version" and opens the new
Angebot, that the form shows its number, Version and proposed Gültig ab, that
the "Versionen" smart button lists the versions with the columns Version,
Gültig ab, Gültig bis and Versionsstatus, and that the quotation report
prints the version under the number (TEST_CASES_QUOTE_VERSIONING.md TC-02,
TC-08, TC-10).
Version 1 is arranged as confirmed yesterday: a version valid today must
start after version 1, and a Sonderreinigung Auftrag (always Einmalig) is
proposed today rather than the 1st of next month.
Requires: fixture property "Testobjekt Wien" linked to IFMS GmbH, the seeded
Kategorie "Sonderreinigung" with a product, and the signers "Administrator"
and "Test Unterzeichner".
